replay_note: W4 re-derivation binds source_head == checkout HEAD; to replay, checkout source_head, rebuild the in-memory W0/W1/W2/W3 chain with the same builders, then run derive_wave_exit_status(w4, source_admission_receipt=admission, predecessor_wave_receipt=w3_wave_exit, predecessor_wave_chain=(w0_wave_exit, w1_wave_exit, w2_wave_exit))

review_provenance.disposition: all P0/P1 fixed in-branch with regressions; the preflight checklist it produced feeds the eventual W6 operator packet
review_provenance.headline: The crash matrix proves the WAL is honest, never that recovery works: no test crashed a run and then completed the install from the wreckage. Doing that surfaced a state that permanently wedges the host and burns both signed permits, and a state where one systemctl read timeout tears down a correct five-row install.
review_provenance.verdict: NOT READY for a W6 operator packet

review_provenance.disposition: CONFLICT and all DRIFT closed or recorded; the ownership question was escalated to PM and ruled on
review_provenance.findings: 1 CONFLICT, 5 DRIFT, no hard-boundary breach, no effect authority acquired
review_provenance.headline: The §9.1 trust-root pin was a self-consistency check inside a WP4-editable file, defeating the one mechanism the design names as separating an operator from a development agent. Separately, ATTESTED_EVIDENCE_CLASS_VERIFIER was assigned to an effect wave, which made it unsatisfiable and would have shipped §10.2's success identity into SOURCE_READY never once exercised.

review_provenance.disposition: all P1 fixed with regressions; P2 fixed or recorded
review_provenance.headline: The install-lock proof was an unauthenticated caller dict and a released verdict passed forever; compensation authority was a shape check on two caller-supplied strings, so two literal all-zero digests converted zero-mutation into authorized destructive reverse compensation.
review_provenance.verdict: four must-holds HOLD; the durability and serialization layer beneath them did not

review_provenance.headline: Startup reconcile's install lane was plan-scoped, so a previous plan's stranded transaction was structurally invisible: plan A crashed with two rows applied on the host and plan B ran to a terminal successful receipt. It also confirmed W4a's PERMIT_PLAN_BINDING, the §5.1 acyclic cut, driver=None zero mutation and §10.5 #24 as genuinely sound.

review_provenance.disposition: all fixed; the edge inventory is now derived from a source AST scan in both directions
review_provenance.findings: 1 P0, 3 P1, 5 P2; 14 mutations run, 10 killed (several with 18-86 failures)
review_provenance.headline: An untyped RuntimeError escaped the frozen §10.2 ABI during compensation, and the crash-matrix inventory was hand-maintained: a brand-new external effect edge added to the success path left all 407 tests green.
review_provenance.verdict: numbers confirmed exactly; coverage real but with four mutation survivors

review_provenance.disposition: all P1 fixed with regressions; this reviewer executed no tests (no admitted verification node), which is stated rather than glossed
review_provenance.headline: The trust-root fix pinned a copy no verifier reads - every verifier resolves the facade, and the facade module is inside _W4_OWNED_PATHS - so a WP4 wave could still re-point the trust root for all four permits and the apply attestation. PM confirmed this dynamically.
review_provenance.verdict: four must-holds still HOLD; the remediation itself carried defects

review_provenance.disposition: all P0/P1 fixed; each fix carries a regression proven red under the exact surviving mutation
review_provenance.findings: 2 P0, 5 P1, 12 P2; 40 mutations run, 9 survived
review_provenance.headline: Two of the wave's own claims were false: the SSHSIG verification that is the only key to APPLIED_INACTIVE had zero test coverage (a one-line regression minted it from garbage bytes with the whole suite green), and COMPENSATED_EXACT could still be bought by a constant-returning verifier on the crash matrix's own second failure mode. ALREADY_APPLIED_IDEMPOTENT was a new fail-open converting an unknown or partially-applied host into 'no operator action is required'.

review_provenance.disposition: receipts emitted only after both recheck legs returned and their findings were closed
review_provenance.headline: Ruled that ATTESTED_EVIDENCE_CLASS_VERIFIER moves from W6B to the source lane on the S2.0 precedent. Independently re-derived the whole-tree numbers, both CLIs, the adapter statuses and the trust-root facade exploit rather than accepting the builders' reports.

authority_posture.applied_inactive_reachability: gated on real SSHSIG verification of s2_4_install_apply_attestation_v1; no source-side input reaches it. What keeps production out of reach is key custody, not structural unreachability - this changed in W4 and is stated in the Registry and the W4 ABI rather than left implicit.
